title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
snippet: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher, assuming that the teacher can reach a correct answer from any prefix the student writes. We call this property the recoverability of the teacher and show it fails on incorrect rollouts: the teacher follows student errors, although it recognizes them. We propose CriticOPD, using error recognition to restore recoverability. The teacher critiques an incorrect rollout, allowing the student to rewrite its solution following the error. summary: CriticOPD proposes having a teacher model critique incorrect student rollouts so the student can rewrite them, fixing a failure mode in on-policy distillation.
